title: web.search output
description: One pure web.search result page from the admitted adapter backend. Titles, URLs, descriptions, and ages are TrustClass::Untrusted web content with adapter provenance; they are never policy and are never silently invented. An empty results array with resultCount 0 is a valid outcome; backend names the declared search backend (SearXNG, or the Brave fallback) that served the page. Only HTTPS result URLs are accepted.

backend.description: The declared search backend that served this page.
